item.description: Fixed Update Error across recent updates

Card Layout Changes, Performance Improvements, and more bug fixes...
## What's New - Added resolution and bitrate controls to Convert. - Added source details to Same as Source options in Convert. - Redesigned the Download and Convert card: fewer rows, dropdown fields for codec and bitrate. - Convert shows an estimated Auto bitrate when the source file doesn't report one. - Convert resolution options now show their common name, like 4K Ultra HD. - Re-added MOV as a Download format, for sources that can actually use it.
## Changed - Edit is now hidden in the Convert queue while a conversion is running. - Every icon button now shows a label on hover, and fixed a few non-square ones. - Cleaned up the View menu: added Toggle Sidebar, removed unused tab-bar items. - The options button now shows a settings icon, and every button shows its name on hover.
## Fixes - Improved window resizing performance - Fixed the metadata capsule briefly showing two states at once while a file finishes analyzing. - Fixed Convert dropdown menus that could run past the window edge and stuttered when closing. - Fixed SoundCloud links not showing an estimated download size. - A running download now shows one Cancel button instead of two overlapping ones. - Fixed automatic retries after a blocked download repeating the exact same failed request. - Check for Updates now switches to Checking instantly and can't be clicked mid-result. - Fixed long links truncating in the middle instead of at the end. - Fixed dropdown menus needing two clicks to act on anything else while open. - Fixed a transparent background on Convert's file switcher popup. - Fixed the metadata capsule briefly resizing oddly when switching audio format or tabs. - Fixed the audio bitrate shown for FLAC and M4A not matching the real setting. - Fixed the placeholder shown while resizing not matching a card's real layout.
